observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Stage performance in an auditorium with dark background and a projection screen showing a landscape slide
observation.dancers: Mixed group of men and women, approximately twelve dancers in total
observation.formation_and_space: Group starts in smaller segments, transitions into a single curved line/semi-circle holding hands, moving side to side across the stage
observation.posture: Upright torso, erect posture with engaged core, knees soft and lifting high on steps
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side, crossing steps, and lifting knees high with active foot extension on beats
observation.arms_and_hands: Dancers hold hands in a line with arms extended outwards at shoulder height or bent at elbows; sometimes released for brief solo or sectional flourishes
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright and stable with subtle weight shifts following leg movements; no prominent hip isolations
observation.partnering: None; line dance with hand-in-hand hold
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Standing level throughout, occasional quick low dips of knees, high knee lifts, no floor work
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional-style folk costumes: men in white shirts, dark vests, dark trousers, and red sashes; women in white blouses, dark skirts with decorative borders, aprons, and head coverings
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot articulation and precise weight transfer cannot be determined due to stage lighting and camera distance.

signature_moments.what: The line of male dancers steps side to side while rhythmically lifting their outer legs high with bent knees.
The joined group shifts into a synchronized lateral traveling step, pausing to stamp and lift feet on the beat.
Dancers perform a coordinated deep knee bend while holding hands in a semi-circle line.
